title: rpackit 0.1.1
text: Added plan_dependencies() non-executing dependency discovery parsed R calls, DESCRIPTION, renv.lock. Added explicit dependency precedence, provenance, diagnostics, clear read/parse failures. Updated check_app() use parsed source dependencies preserving existing packages result. Added prepare_desktop() validate_desktop_bundle() atomic, portable-R-backed desktop resource bundles explicit launcher versioned manifest contract. Added start_desktop_app(), desktop_app_status(), stop_desktop_app() real Shiny child-process readiness, status, graceful shutdown, forced tracked-process termination, structured startup failures. Desktop status distinguishes processx wrapper PID launcher-reported runtime PID, required portable R Windows, uses create-time-aware runtime handle confirming cleanup. Extended launcher versioned NDJSON lifecycle events optional private control-file argument suitable future Tauri sidecar, continuing record network token enforcement implemented. doctor() now requires Tauri CLI, JavaScript package manager, native platform toolchain, WebView2 Windows reporting Tauri desktop build supported.
